name: net_forced_resync_outsider_seatstate
description: VUH-2675 D14: three seats converge in empty GoA, the host forces a single-target resync of Friend1 only, then Friend2 (outside the resync) must keep admitting Friend1's SeatState. Friend2's runtime must log Friend1's new delivery serial (2: the first resync of a fresh connection) from the relay's plan notice, without being fenced itself. Friend2's DLL must log new accepted owner=1 seats after that notice is verified (the baselines are taken after it) and after convergence, with the host and Friend1 as controls. The exact-one and outsider-only serial checks repeat at the end of the run. The scenario is otherwise net_forced_resync_smoke's exact checks (Converged native acknowledgment, relay and host terminal, two complete statehash samples, census). It does not exercise StageEnd (no event here), and it cannot show Friend2 refusing an old-serial envelope: the relay refuses a stale source serial first (SessionHost source-delivery), so that clause stays with ForcedResyncTest outsiderAdmitsRecoveredSeat.

steps.expr: all(row['count'] == 0 and row['unmatched'] == 0 for row in saved['before']['instances'].values())
steps.message: the room must be empty on every seat before the resync

steps.expr: log_count('[prologue] seat accepted owner=1', 2) >= 3 and log_count('[prologue] seat accepted owner=1', 0) >= 3
'peer delivery slot=' not in runtime_log(2) and 'peer delivery slot=' not in runtime_log(1)
steps.message: no peer serial moved before the forced resync

steps.expr: '[Runtime] peer delivery slot=1 serial=' in runtime_log(2)
[line.split('serial=')[1].split(' ')[0] for line in runtime_log(2).splitlines() if '[Runtime] peer delivery slot=' in line] == ['2']
steps.message: Friend2 recorded exactly one peer serial move: Friend1 to 2

steps.expr: 'peer delivery slot=' not in runtime_log(1) and 'peer delivery slot=' not in runtime_log(0)
steps.message: the notice path ran only on the outsider (the target and host take the plan itself)

steps.expr: all(row['count'] == 0 and row['unmatched'] == 0 for row in saved['after']['instances'].values())
steps.message: the room must stay empty on every seat after the resync

steps.expr: log_count('[event-mirror] stage end envelope drop', 2) == 0 and '[stage-end] envelope drop' not in runtime_log(2)
[line.split('serial=')[1].split(' ')[0] for line in runtime_log(2).splitlines() if '[Runtime] peer delivery slot=' in line] == ['2']
steps.message: at the end of the run Friend2 still recorded exactly one peer serial move: Friend1 to 2

steps.expr: 'peer delivery slot=' not in runtime_log(1) and 'peer delivery slot=' not in runtime_log(0)
steps.message: at the end of the run neither the host nor Friend1 logged a peer serial move
